units.source_text: 在某饭店的台阶，他偶然邂逅了她。

en.t: On the steps of a certain restaurant, he happened to encounter her.

units.source_text: 即使是在白天，她的脸也跟在月光下一样。

en.t: Even in the daytime, her face looked just as it did under the moonlight.

units.source_text: 他目送着她（他俩并不相识），感到从未有过的寂寞……

en.t: As he watched her go, though the two of them did not know each other, he felt a loneliness unlike anything he had ever known...
